answer: Farming becomes a ridge bet on surviving 85 epochs of grading, and every reef settlement recomputes the horizon schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 85 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 7 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
